user_query: I'm planning a surprise road trip for my family and I need some exciting destinations to visit. Can you suggest some offbeat locations and provide me with interesting facts about each place? Also, share a quote about travel to ignite our wanderlust.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of offbeat travel destinations suitable for a family road trip.
For each offbeat destination, gather interesting facts that highlight the uniqueness and attractions of the place.
Retrieve a quote about travel to inspire and ignite wanderlust.
